WITH jobs_latest AS (
  SELECT
    workspace_id,
    job_id,
    name,
    tags
  FROM
    system.lakeflow.jobs
  QUALIFY
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY workspace_id, job_id ORDER BY change_time DESC) = 1
),
priced_usage AS (
  SELECT
    u.workspace_id,
    u.usage_metadata.job_id AS job_id,
    u.usage_quantity,
    COALESCE(
      TRY_CAST(lp.pricing.effective_list.default AS DECIMAL(38, 10)),
      TRY_CAST(lp.pricing.default AS DECIMAL(38, 10)),
      CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(38, 10))
    ) AS unit_price
  FROM
    system.billing.usage u
      LEFT JOIN system.billing.list_prices lp
        ON u.sku_name = lp.sku_name
        AND u.cloud = lp.cloud
        AND CAST(lp.price_start_time AS DATE) <= u.usage_date
        AND (
          lp.price_end_time IS NULL
          OR u.usage_date < CAST(lp.price_end_time AS DATE)
        )
  WHERE
    u.usage_date = CURRENT_DATE()
    AND u.usage_unit = 'DBU'
    AND u.cloud = 'AZURE'
    AND u.workspace_id = 6657807540631898
    AND u.usage_metadata.job_id IS NOT NULL
  QUALIFY
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY u.record_id ORDER BY lp.price_start_time DESC NULLS LAST) = 1
),
job_costs AS (
  SELECT
    workspace_id,
    job_id,
    ROUND(SUM(usage_quantity * unit_price), 2) AS cost,
    ROUND(SUM(usage_quantity), 2) AS dbu
  FROM
    priced_usage
  GROUP BY
    workspace_id,
    job_id
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(j.name, CAST(jc.job_id AS STRING)) AS `Job Name`,
  COALESCE(element_at(j.tags, 'app'), 'Unknown') AS `APP`,
  jc.cost AS `COST`,
  jc.dbu AS `DBU`
FROM
  job_costs jc
    LEFT JOIN jobs_latest j
      ON jc.workspace_id = j.workspace_id
      AND jc.job_id = j.job_id
ORDER BY
  jc.cost DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH job_stats AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS total_jobs
  FROM
    (
      SELECT
        job_id
      FROM
        system.lakeflow.jobs
      WHERE
        workspace_id = '6657807540631898'
      QUALIFY
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY job_id ORDER BY change_time DESC) = 1
        AND delete_time IS NULL
    )
),
run_stats AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT
      CASE
        WHEN result_state IS NULL THEN run_id
      END
    ) AS active_runs,
    COUNT(DISTINCT
      CASE
        WHEN result_state IN ('FAILED', 'TIMEDOUT', 'CANCELED') THEN run_id
      END
    ) AS failed_runs_lookback
  FROM
    (
      SELECT
        run_id,
        result_state
      FROM
        system.lakeflow.job_run_timeline
      WHERE
        workspace_id = '6657807540631898'
        AND period_start_time >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() - INTERVAL 24 HOURS
      QUALIFY
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY run_id ORDER BY period_end_time DESC NULLS FIRST) = 1
    )
),
cluster_activity AS (
  SELECT
    c.cluster_id,
    CASE
      WHEN la.last_active >= NOW() - INTERVAL 30 MINUTES THEN 'RUNNING'
      ELSE 'TERMINATED'
    END AS state
  FROM
    (
      SELECT
        cluster_id
      FROM
        system.compute.clusters
      WHERE
        workspace_id = '6657807540631898'
        AND cluster_source IN ('UI', 'API')
      QUALIFY
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cluster_id ORDER BY change_time DESC) = 1
        AND delete_time IS NULL
    ) c
      LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT
          cluster_id,
          MAX(end_time) AS last_active
        FROM
          system.compute.node_timeline
        WHERE
          workspace_id = '6657807540631898'
          AND start_time >= CURRENT_DATE() - INTERVAL 7 DAY
        GROUP BY
          cluster_id
      ) la
        ON c.cluster_id = la.cluster_id
),
cluster_stats AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS total_clusters,
    COUNT(
      CASE
        WHEN state = 'RUNNING' THEN 1
      END
    ) AS running_clusters,
    COUNT(
      CASE
        WHEN state = 'TERMINATED' THEN 1
      END
    ) AS terminated_clusters
  FROM
    cluster_activity
),
policy_count AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT policy_id) AS cluster_policies
  FROM
    (
      SELECT
        cluster_id,
        policy_id
      FROM
        system.compute.clusters
      WHERE
        workspace_id = '6657807540631898'
        AND policy_id IS NOT NULL
      QUALIFY
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cluster_id ORDER BY change_time DESC) = 1
        AND delete_time IS NULL
    )
)
SELECT
  CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS snapshot_ts,
  'PROD' AS env,
  '6657807540631898' AS workspace_id,
  CAST(j.total_jobs AS BIGINT) AS total_jobs,
  CAST(r.active_runs AS BIGINT) AS active_runs,
  CAST(r.failed_runs_lookback AS BIGINT) AS failed_runs_lookback,
  CAST(cs.total_clusters AS BIGINT) AS total_clusters,
  CAST(cs.running_clusters AS BIGINT) AS running_clusters,
  CAST(cs.terminated_clusters AS BIGINT) AS terminated_clusters,
  CAST(0 AS BIGINT) AS error_clusters,
  CAST(0 AS BIGINT) AS pending_clusters,
  CAST(0 AS BIGINT) AS restarting_clusters,
  CAST(0 AS BIGINT) AS resized_clusters,
  CAST(0 AS BIGINT) AS unknown_clusters,
  COALESCE(CAST(p.cluster_policies AS BIGINT), 0) AS cluster_policies,
  CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS ingest_ts
FROM
  job_stats j CROSS JOIN run_stats r CROSS JOIN cluster_stats cs CROSS JOIN policy_count p

WITH date_series AS (
  SELECT
    EXPLODE(
      SEQUENCE(CURRENT_DATE() - INTERVAL 90 DAY, CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
    ) AS snapshot_date
),
job_events AS (
  SELECT
    job_id,
    MIN(change_time) AS created_date,
    MAX(delete_time) AS deleted_date
  FROM
    system.lakeflow.jobs
  WHERE
    workspace_id = '6657807540631898'
  GROUP BY
    job_id
),
cumulative_jobs AS (
  SELECT
    d.snapshot_date,
    COUNT(DISTINCT
      CASE
        WHEN
          CAST(je.created_date AS DATE) <= d.snapshot_date
          AND (
            je.deleted_date IS NULL
            OR CAST(je.deleted_date AS DATE) > d.snapshot_date
          )
        THEN
          je.job_id
      END
    ) AS total_jobs
  FROM
    date_series d CROSS JOIN job_events je
  GROUP BY
    d.snapshot_date
),
daily_runs AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(period_start_time AS DATE) AS run_date,
    COUNT(DISTINCT run_id) AS daily_runs,
    COUNT(DISTINCT
      CASE
        WHEN result_state IN ('FAILED', 'TIMEDOUT', 'CANCELED') THEN run_id
      END
    ) AS failed_runs
  FROM
    (
      SELECT
        run_id,
        period_start_time,
        result_state
      FROM
        system.lakeflow.job_run_timeline
      WHERE
        workspace_id = '6657807540631898'
        AND period_start_time >= CURRENT_DATE() - INTERVAL 90 DAY
      QUALIFY
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY run_id, CAST(period_start_time AS DATE)
            ORDER BY period_end_time DESC NULLS FIRST
          ) = 1
    )
  GROUP BY
    CAST(period_start_time AS DATE)
),
cluster_events AS (
  SELECT
    cluster_id,
    MIN(change_time) AS created_date,
    MAX(delete_time) AS deleted_date
  FROM
    system.compute.clusters
  WHERE
    workspace_id = '6657807540631898'
    AND cluster_source IN ('UI', 'API')
  GROUP BY
    cluster_id
),
cumulative_clusters AS (
  SELECT
    d.snapshot_date,
    COUNT(DISTINCT
      CASE
        WHEN
          CAST(ce.created_date AS DATE) <= d.snapshot_date
          AND (
            ce.deleted_date IS NULL
            OR CAST(ce.deleted_date AS DATE) > d.snapshot_date
          )
        THEN
          ce.cluster_id
      END
    ) AS total_clusters
  FROM
    date_series d CROSS JOIN cluster_events ce
  GROUP BY
    d.snapshot_date
),
daily_cluster_activity AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(start_time AS DATE) AS activity_date,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cluster_id) AS active_clusters
  FROM
    system.compute.node_timeline
  WHERE
    workspace_id = '6657807540631898'
    AND start_time >= CURRENT_DATE() - INTERVAL 90 DAY
  GROUP BY
    CAST(start_time AS DATE)
),
policy_count AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT policy_id) AS cluster_policies
  FROM
    (
      SELECT
        cluster_id,
        policy_id
      FROM
        system.compute.clusters
      WHERE
        workspace_id = '6657807540631898'
        AND policy_id IS NOT NULL
      QUALIFY
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cluster_id ORDER BY change_time DESC) = 1
        AND delete_time IS NULL
    )
)
SELECT
  CAST(d.snapshot_date AS TIMESTAMP) AS snapshot_ts,
  'PROD' AS env,
  '6657807540631898' AS workspace_id,
  CAST(COALESCE(cj.total_jobs, 0) AS BIGINT) AS total_jobs,
  CAST(COALESCE(r.daily_runs, 0) AS BIGINT) AS active_runs,
  CAST(COALESCE(r.failed_runs, 0) AS BIGINT) AS failed_runs_lookback,
  CAST(COALESCE(cc.total_clusters, 0) AS BIGINT) AS total_clusters,
  CAST(COALESCE(dca.active_clusters, 0) AS BIGINT) AS running_clusters,
  CAST(
    GREATEST(COALESCE(cc.total_clusters, 0) - COALESCE(dca.active_clusters, 0), 0) AS BIGINT
  ) AS terminated_clusters,
  CAST(0 AS BIGINT) AS error_clusters,
  CAST(0 AS BIGINT) AS pending_clusters,
  CAST(0 AS BIGINT) AS restarting_clusters,
  CAST(0 AS BIGINT) AS resized_clusters,
  CAST(0 AS BIGINT) AS unknown_clusters,
  CAST(COALESCE(pc.cluster_policies, 0) AS BIGINT) AS cluster_policies,
  CAST(d.snapshot_date AS TIMESTAMP) AS ingest_ts
FROM
  date_series d
    LEFT JOIN cumulative_jobs cj
      ON d.snapshot_date = cj.snapshot_date
    LEFT JOIN daily_runs r
      ON d.snapshot_date = r.run_date
    LEFT JOIN cumulative_clusters cc
      ON d.snapshot_date = cc.snapshot_date
    LEFT JOIN daily_cluster_activity dca
      ON d.snapshot_date = dca.activity_date
    CROSS JOIN policy_count pc
ORDER BY
  d.snapshot_date DESC

WITH cluster_config AS (
  SELECT
    cluster_name,
    cluster_id,
    owned_by,
    cluster_source,
    dbr_version,
    driver_node_type,
    worker_node_type,
    worker_count,
    min_autoscale_workers,
    max_autoscale_workers,
    auto_termination_minutes,
    data_security_mode,
    create_time
  FROM
    system.compute.clusters
  WHERE
    workspace_id = '6657807540631898'
    AND delete_time IS NULL
    AND cluster_source IN ('UI', 'API')
  QUALIFY
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cluster_id ORDER BY change_time DESC) = 1
),
last_activity AS (
  SELECT
    cluster_id,
    MAX(end_time) AS last_active
  FROM
    system.compute.node_timeline
  WHERE
    workspace_id = '6657807540631898'
    AND start_time >= CURRENT_DATE() - INTERVAL 7 DAY
  GROUP BY
    cluster_id
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN la.last_active >= NOW() - INTERVAL 30 MINUTES THEN 'RUNNING'
    ELSE 'TERMINATED'
  END AS state,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(c.cluster_name, ''), 'Unnamed Cluster') AS cluster_name,
  c.cluster_id,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(c.owned_by, ''), 'System') AS owned_by,
  c.cluster_source,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(c.dbr_version, ''), 'N/A') AS dbr_version,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(c.driver_node_type, ''), 'N/A') AS driver_node_type,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(c.worker_node_type, ''), 'N/A') AS worker_node_type,
  c.worker_count,
  c.auto_termination_minutes,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(c.data_security_mode, ''), 'None') AS data_security_mode,
  c.create_time,
  la.last_active
FROM
  cluster_config c
    LEFT JOIN last_activity la
      ON c.cluster_id = la.cluster_id
ORDER BY
  CASE
    WHEN la.last_active >= NOW() - INTERVAL 30 MINUTES THEN 0
    ELSE 1
  END,
  c.cluster_name

queryLines:
WITH jobs_latest AS (
  SELECT
    workspace_id,
    job_id,
    name,
    COALESCE(element_at(tags, 'app'), 'Unknown') AS app_tag
  FROM
    system.lakeflow.jobs
  WHERE
    workspace_id = '6657807540631898'
  QUALIFY
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY workspace_id, job_id ORDER BY change_time DESC) = 1
)
SELECT
  u.usage_date,
  u.sku_name,
  u.usage_quantity AS dbu,
  COALESCE(
    TRY_CAST(lp.pricing.effective_list.default AS DECIMAL(38, 10)),
    TRY_CAST(lp.pricing.default AS DECIMAL(38, 10)),
    CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(38, 10))
  ) AS unit_price,
  u.billing_origin_product,
  u.usage_metadata.cluster_id AS cluster_id,
  u.usage_metadata.job_id AS job_id,
  COALESCE(j.name, CONCAT('Job ', u.usage_metadata.job_id)) AS job_name,
  COALESCE(j.app_tag, 'Unknown') AS app_tag
FROM
  system.billing.usage u
    LEFT JOIN system.billing.list_prices lp
      ON u.sku_name = lp.sku_name
      AND u.cloud = lp.cloud
      AND CAST(lp.price_start_time AS DATE) <= u.usage_date
      AND (
        lp.price_end_time IS NULL
        OR u.usage_date < CAST(lp.price_end_time AS DATE)
      )
    LEFT JOIN jobs_latest j
      ON CAST(u.usage_metadata.job_id AS STRING) = j.job_id
      AND u.workspace_id = CAST(j.workspace_id AS LONG)
WHERE
  u.usage_date >= CURRENT_DATE() - INTERVAL 1 YEAR
  AND u.usage_unit = 'DBU'
  AND u.cloud = 'AZURE'
  AND u.workspace_id = 6657807540631898
  AND (
    u.sku_name LIKE '%JOBS%'

WITH deduped_usage AS (

        CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(38, 10))
      ) AS row_cost
  FROM
    system.billing.usage u
      LEFT JOIN system.billing.list_prices lp
        ON u.sku_name = lp.sku_name
        AND u.cloud = lp.cloud
        AND CAST(lp.price_start_time AS DATE) <= u.usage_date
        AND (
          lp.price_end_time IS NULL
          OR u.usage_date < CAST(lp.price_end_time AS DATE)
        )
  WHERE
    u.workspace_id = '6657807540631898'
    AND u.cloud = 'AZURE'
    AND u.usage_unit = 'DBU'
    AND u.usage_date >= CURRENT_DATE() - INTERVAL 35 DAY
  QUALIFY
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY u.record_id ORDER BY lp.price_start_time DESC NULLS LAST) = 1
),
daily_costs AS (
  SELECT
    usage_date,
    ROUND(SUM(row_cost), 2) AS total_cost
  FROM
    deduped_usage
  GROUP BY
    usage_date
),
yesterday_vs_prior AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN usage_date = CURRENT_DATE() - INTERVAL 1 DAY THEN total_cost
      END
    ) AS yesterday_cost,
    MAX(
      CASE
        WHEN usage_date = CURRENT_DATE() - INTERVAL 2 DAY THEN total_cost
      END
    ) AS day_before_cost,
    AVG(
      CASE
        WHEN
          usage_date BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE() - INTERVAL 8 DAY AND CURRENT_DATE() - INTERVAL 2 DAY
        THEN
          total_cost
      END
    ) AS week_avg_cost,
    AVG(
      CASE
        WHEN
          usage_date BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE() - INTERVAL 31 DAY AND CURRENT_DATE() - INTERVAL 2 DAY
        THEN
          total_cost
      END
    ) AS month_avg_cost
  FROM
    daily_costs
),
top_product AS (
  SELECT
    product,
    ROUND(SUM(row_cost), 2) AS product_cost
  FROM
    deduped_usage
  WHERE
    usage_date >= CURRENT_DATE() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
  GROUP BY
    product
  ORDER BY
    product_cost DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
total_30d AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(total_cost) AS total_30d_cost
  FROM
    daily_costs
  WHERE
    usage_date >= CURRENT_DATE() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
)
SELECT
  1 AS sort_order,
  'Cost Trend' AS insight_category,
  CONCAT(
    'Yesterday''s cost was $',
    ROUND(COALESCE(v.yesterday_cost, 0), 0),
    CASE
      WHEN
        v.day_before_cost > 0
        AND v.yesterday_cost > v.day_before_cost
      THEN
        CONCAT(
          ' (up ',
          ROUND((v.yesterday_cost - v.day_before_cost) / v.day_before_cost * 100, 1),
          '% vs prior day)'
        )
      WHEN
        v.day_before_cost > 0
        AND v.yesterday_cost < v.day_before_cost
      THEN
        CONCAT(
          ' (down ',
          ROUND((v.day_before_cost - v.yesterday_cost) / v.day_before_cost * 100, 1),
          '% vs prior day)'
        )
      ELSE ' (no prior day comparison)'
    END
  ) AS insight_text,
  CASE
    WHEN
      v.day_before_cost > 0
      AND v.yesterday_cost > v.day_before_cost * 1.1
    THEN
      'WARNING'
    WHEN
      v.day_before_cost > 0
      AND v.yesterday_cost < v.day_before_cost * 0.9
    THEN
      'GOOD'
    ELSE 'NEUTRAL'
  END AS severity
FROM
  yesterday_vs_prior v
UNION ALL
SELECT
  2,
  'Weekly Trend',
  CONCAT(
    '7-day avg daily cost is $',
    ROUND(COALESCE(v.week_avg_cost, 0), 0),
    CASE
      WHEN
        v.month_avg_cost > 0
        AND v.week_avg_cost > v.month_avg_cost
      THEN
        CONCAT(
          ' (up ',
          ROUND((v.week_avg_cost - v.month_avg_cost) / v.month_avg_cost * 100, 1),
          '% above 30-day avg)'
        )
      WHEN
        v.month_avg_cost > 0
        AND v.week_avg_cost < v.month_avg_cost
      THEN
        CONCAT(
          ' (down ',
          ROUND((v.month_avg_cost - v.week_avg_cost) / v.month_avg_cost * 100, 1),
          '% below 30-day avg)'
        )
      ELSE ''
    END
  ),
  CASE
    WHEN
      v.month_avg_cost > 0
      AND v.week_avg_cost > v.month_avg_cost * 1.15
    THEN
      'WARNING'
    WHEN
      v.month_avg_cost > 0
      AND v.week_avg_cost < v.month_avg_cost * 0.85
    THEN
      'GOOD'
    ELSE 'NEUTRAL'
  END
FROM
  yesterday_vs_prior v
UNION ALL
SELECT
  3,
  'Top Driver',
  CONCAT(
    p.product,
    ' is your top cost driver at $',
    ROUND(p.product_cost, 0),
    ' (',
    ROUND(p.product_cost / NULLIF(t.total_30d_cost, 0) * 100, 1),
    '% of 30-day spend)'
  ),
  CASE
    WHEN p.product_cost / NULLIF(t.total_30d_cost, 0) > 0.5 THEN 'WARNING'
    ELSE 'NEUTRAL'
  END
FROM
  top_product p CROSS JOIN total_30d t
ORDER BY
  sort_order

WITH cluster_config AS (
  SELECT
    cluster_id,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(cluster_name, ''), 'Unnamed Cluster') AS cluster_name,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(owned_by, ''), 'System') AS owned_by,
    worker_count,
    min_autoscale_workers,
    max_autoscale_workers
  FROM
    system.compute.clusters
  WHERE
    workspace_id = '6657807540631898'
    AND cluster_source IN ('UI', 'API')
  QUALIFY
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cluster_id ORDER BY change_time DESC) = 1
    AND delete_time IS NULL
),
node_hours AS (
  SELECT
    n.cluster_id,
    CAST(n.start_time AS DATE) AS usage_date,
    COUNT(DISTINCT n.instance_id) AS node_count,
    ROUND(SUM(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, n.start_time, n.end_time)) / 3600.0, 2) AS total_node_hours
  FROM
    system.compute.node_timeline n
  WHERE
    n.workspace_id = '6657807540631898'
    AND n.start_time >= CURRENT_DATE() - INTERVAL 90 DAY
  GROUP BY
    n.cluster_id,
    CAST(n.start_time AS DATE)
),
billing_deduped AS (
  SELECT
    u.usage_metadata.cluster_id AS cluster_id,
    u.usage_date,
    u.usage_quantity AS dbu,
    u.usage_quantity
      * COALESCE(
        TRY_CAST(lp.pricing.effective_list.default AS DECIMAL(38, 10)),
        TRY_CAST(lp.pricing.default AS DECIMAL(38, 10)),
        CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(38, 10))
      ) AS cost
  FROM
    system.billing.usage u
      LEFT JOIN system.billing.list_prices lp
        ON u.sku_name = lp.sku_name
        AND u.cloud = lp.cloud
        AND CAST(lp.price_start_time AS DATE) <= u.usage_date
        AND (
          lp.price_end_time IS NULL
          OR u.usage_date < CAST(lp.price_end_time AS DATE)
        )
  WHERE
    u.usage_date >= CURRENT_DATE() - INTERVAL 90 DAY
    AND u.usage_unit = 'DBU'
    AND u.cloud = 'AZURE'
    AND u.workspace_id = 6657807540631898
    AND (
      u.sku_name LIKE '%ALL_PURPOSE%'
      OR u.sku_name LIKE '%ALL PURPOSE%'
    )
  QUALIFY
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY u.record_id ORDER BY lp.price_start_time DESC NULLS LAST) = 1
),
billing_hours AS (
  SELECT
    cluster_id,
    usage_date,
    SUM(dbu) AS total_dbu,
    SUM(cost) AS total_cost
  FROM
    billing_deduped
  GROUP BY
    cluster_id,
    usage_date
)
SELECT
  nh.usage_date,
  c.cluster_name,
  c.owned_by,
  nh.node_count,
  nh.total_node_hours,
  COALESCE(bh.total_dbu, 0) AS total_dbu,
  COALESCE(bh.total_cost, 0) AS total_cost,
  CASE
    WHEN nh.total_node_hours > 0 THEN ROUND(COALESCE(bh.total_dbu, 0) / nh.total_node_hours, 2)
    ELSE 0
  END AS dbu_per_node_hour
FROM
  node_hours nh
    JOIN cluster_config c
      ON nh.cluster_id = c.cluster_id
    LEFT JOIN billing_hours bh
      ON nh.cluster_id = bh.cluster_id
      AND nh.usage_date = bh.usage_date
ORDER BY
  nh.usage_date DESC,
  c.cluster_name

WITH cluster_perf AS (
  SELECT
    n.cluster_id,
    ROUND(AVG(n.cpu_user_percent + n.cpu_system_percent), 2) AS avg_cpu_util,
    ROUND(MAX(n.cpu_user_percent + n.cpu_system_percent), 2) AS peak_cpu_util,
    ROUND(AVG(n.cpu_wait_percent), 2) AS avg_cpu_disk_wait,
    ROUND(MAX(n.cpu_wait_percent), 2) AS max_cpu_disk_wait,
    ROUND(AVG(n.mem_used_percent), 2) AS avg_mem_util,
    ROUND(MAX(n.mem_used_percent), 2) AS max_mem_util,
    ROUND(AVG(n.mem_swap_percent), 2) AS avg_swap_pct,
    ROUND(MAX(n.mem_swap_percent), 2) AS max_swap_pct,
    ROUND(SUM(n.network_sent_bytes) / 1073741824.0, 2) AS total_network_sent_gb,
    ROUND(SUM(n.network_received_bytes) / 1073741824.0, 2) AS total_network_recv_gb,
    COUNT(DISTINCT n.instance_id) AS unique_nodes,
    COUNT(*) AS sample_count
  FROM
    system.compute.node_timeline n
  WHERE
    n.workspace_id = '6657807540631898'
    AND n.start_time >= CURRENT_DATE() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
    AND n.cpu_user_percent IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    n.cluster_id
),
cluster_config AS (
  SELECT
    cluster_id,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(cluster_name, ''), 'Unnamed Cluster') AS cluster_name,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(owned_by, ''), 'System') AS owned_by,
    worker_count,
    min_autoscale_workers,
    max_autoscale_workers,
    auto_termination_minutes,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(dbr_version, ''), 'N/A') AS dbr_version,
    COALESCE(azure_attributes.availability, 'UNKNOWN') AS spot_availability,
    cluster_source
  FROM
    system.compute.clusters
  WHERE
    workspace_id = '6657807540631898'
  QUALIFY
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cluster_id ORDER BY change_time DESC) = 1
),
job_cluster_map AS (
  SELECT
    u.usage_metadata.cluster_id AS cluster_id,
    u.usage_metadata.job_id AS job_id,
    SUM(u.usage_quantity) AS total_dbu
  FROM
    system.billing.usage u
  WHERE
    u.workspace_id = 6657807540631898
    AND u.usage_date >= CURRENT_DATE() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
    AND u.usage_unit = 'DBU'
    AND u.cloud = 'AZURE'
    AND u.usage_metadata.job_id IS NOT NULL
    AND u.usage_metadata.cluster_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    u.usage_metadata.cluster_id,
    u.usage_metadata.job_id
),
jobs_latest AS (
  SELECT
    job_id,
    name AS job_name,
    COALESCE(element_at(tags, 'app'), 'Unknown') AS app_tag
  FROM
    system.lakeflow.jobs
  WHERE
    workspace_id = '6657807540631898'
  QUALIFY
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY job_id ORDER BY change_time DESC) = 1
)
SELECT
  p.cluster_id,
  COALESCE(c.cluster_name, 'Unknown Cluster') AS cluster_name,
  COALESCE(c.owned_by, 'System') AS owned_by,
  COALESCE(c.dbr_version, 'N/A') AS dbr_version,
  COALESCE(c.worker_count, 0) AS worker_count,
  c.min_autoscale_workers,
  c.max_autoscale_workers,
  c.auto_termination_minutes,
  COALESCE(c.spot_availability, 'UNKNOWN') AS spot_availability,

  CASE
    WHEN c.cluster_source = 'JOB' THEN 'Job Cluster'
    WHEN c.cluster_source IN ('UI', 'API') THEN 'All-Purpose'
    ELSE 'Other'
  END AS cluster_type,
  COALESCE(j.job_name, 'Interactive / No Job') AS job_name,
  COALESCE(j.app_tag, 'N/A') AS app_tag,
  COALESCE(CAST(jcm.job_id AS STRING), 'N/A') AS job_id,
  COALESCE(jcm.total_dbu, 0) AS job_dbu_30d,
  p.avg_cpu_util,

  p.avg_cpu_disk_wait,
  p.max_cpu_disk_wait,
  p.avg_mem_util,
  p.max_mem_util,

  p.total_network_sent_gb,

FROM
